title: docs(spec): the permission set name describe and the permission sets page say one holder per namespace
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTb7VngXcrRUydhcV2b3MnX)_

Fixes #32758

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:权限集 `name` 字段的 describe 不再说「在环境的安全目录里唯一」,改成「权限集按 (包, 名字) 识别,每个命名空间一个持有者」;参考文档那一行重新生成;权限集指南里「权限集、岗位、能力每个部署一个名字」改成权限集按命名空间、岗位和能力仍按部署。
- 为什么改:#32742(2026-11-12 合入)让两个不同命名空间的包可以各持有同名权限集,这两处文字从那时起就是错的;技能包 `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` 已经按 (包, 名字) 讲,没有改。
- 风险与回滚:只改说明文字,不动 schema、规则或运行时;spec patch changeset。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` 里 `name` 的 describe;其次 `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` 改动的那一段。
- 两分钟验证:`grep -n "one holder per namespace" content/docs/references/security/permission.mdx`,预期 `name` 行命中一次,且与 `permission.zod.ts` 的 describe 逐字一致。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`: the `name` `describe()` and its JSDoc line. FROM "Permission set name, unique within the security catalog the environment serves (lowercase snake_case)" TO "Permission set name (lowercase snake_case). A set is identified by its package and name: a name has one holder per namespace, so packages of two namespaces may each hold a set of one name, while two packages of one namespace, a package with no namespace, a platform package (base, system, sys), the environment and the platform-requested guest_portal share one set of it". The holder list is the one #32742's save-door sentence and `permissionSetHoldersMeet` (`@objectstack/core`) state. The `//` comment above the field gains one line pointing at ADR-0150 D2/D9 and that predicate. `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` and the field are unchanged.
- `content/docs/references/security/permission.mdx`: the generated `name` row, regenerated (`pnpm gen:schema && pnpm gen:docs` in `packages/spec`). No other generated file carries the string; `json-schema/` is untracked build output.
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (the "set shipped in code cannot be edited" bullet): FROM "A set is never overridden under its own name, not even from `.custom`: permission sets, positions and capabilities hold one name per deployment (ADR-0146 D6)." TO: the set is still never overridden under its own name, now for the reason that holds (a permission set takes no override, ADR-0146 D6, and a set of the shipped set's name saved into the pair is refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE`); a permission set is identified by its package and name (ADR-0150 D2), one holder per namespace, with the one-holder cases listed; positions and capabilities keep one name per deployment.
- `.changeset/32758-permission-set-name-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, since the describe ships in spec `dist`.

## Why

PR #32742 (merged 2026-11-12, `5defbfeb`) made a permission-set name one holder per namespace: two packages of two namespaces may each hold a set of one name, judged by `permissionSetHoldersMeet`. Both texts still said one name per deployment.

**The `.custom` sentence, measured against #32742.** The order asked whether "a set is never overridden under its own name, not even from `.custom`" is still true. The pair's namespace is `NAMESPACE_custom` (the base's namespace plus `_custom`), a different namespace from its base, so the name rule alone would admit a second set there. A probe on this head (the real protocol over the real `ObjectQL` engine and an in-memory driver, the harness of `protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`; base `com.example.showcase`, namespace `showcase`, shipping `showcase_reader`; pair created by `ensureCustomizationPackage`, namespace `showcase_custom`) answered:

| Write | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Save `showcase_reader` into the pair, no `overrides` | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("provided by a managed package and is sealed against in-place edits. Clone it under a new name…") |
| Save it into the pair with `overrides: { package: BASE, basedOn: '1.0.0' }` | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("a permission takes no override (ADR-0146 D6)…") |
| Save it with no package | `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (sealed) |
| Save it into the base | `403 ITEM_LOCKED` |

After the refused pair save, the base's set still read "Shipped label". So the point stays true and is kept; only its reason changed. The probe was a scratch file, deleted before the commit.

## Tests

- No behaviour changes, so no test is added and nothing is ablated. The old describe string is pinned nowhere (`git grep` on `origin/main`: only the source, the generated row and released CHANGELOGs).
- On `854b36e4`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/security/permission`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 164 passed (164).

## Acceptance notes

Outside this card's surface, present-tense "one name per deployment" for permission sets remains in:

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.security-catalog-environment-overlay-refused.ts` (`reason`: "Positions, permission sets and capabilities hold one name per deployment"). A migration entry's text, left alone per the order; in the report's `open_questions`.
- `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts:251-252` (the `adr_0146_d6_security_catalog` basis: "D6: one name per deployment (permission sets, positions, capabilities)"). It describes ADR-0146 D6's basis as written; in `open_questions`.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:2818` and `:2880` (the boot and hot-install refusal sentences for an environment item against a package holder). The environment still meets every holder, so the refusal stays right, but its reason says an assignment names a permission set by its bare name.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts:419` (`PlatformBaselineSetContribution.name`, "unique in the security catalog"). A platform-baseline set lives in a platform namespace, which keeps one holder, so this stays true for what it describes.
- ADR-0048's 2026-10-08 addendum and ADR-0146 D6 text, and the dogfood comments `showcase-security.ts:32` / `showcase-d7-default-profile.dogfood.test.ts:65`: decision records and test comments, not touched.

`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:125` already teaches that permission sets "are identified by package and name", and `:129` that a permission set is never overridden; no skills change.

## Verification

On `854b36e4`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 103 commands. 102 exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` exited 1 in the loop because `check:test-typecheck`'s `tsc -p` died without diagnostics while other gates ran beside it; run alone after the loop it exited 0 ("All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"). `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`; only the spec, lint, objectql and client closures were built), so it is NOT MEASURED here and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: "103 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 102 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.
